newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-POPESCU DOUBTFUL FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POPESCU DOUBTFUL FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Barcelona midfielder Gheorghe Popescu has suffered a leg injury and is a doubtful starter for Romania's World Cup group eight qualifier against Irleand in Bucharest on April 30.
"During last week's Spanish league match against Atletico Madrid I felt a muscle pain in my left leg and immediatley left the pitch," Popescu said by telephone from Spain on Friday.
"Doctors told me after a check the next day that I have a three-centimetre muscle rupture and I have to stay out for at least 10 days."
Popescu is the leading scorer in the 1998 World Cup preliminaries with eight goals. He scored four against Liechtenstein last month.
